text_block_list.text: Oh... I didn't know you were here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. My bad. I was really in the zone.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All my senses were focused in on the
upcoming
race. It felt pretty cool.
